rows.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
rows.comment: Newton (pectoral) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

rows.name: Terry McLaurin
rows.comment: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Laremy Tunsil
rows.comment: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Van Jefferson
rows.comment: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.
